chapter_title_en: The Eighth Heavenly Stele and the Stealer of Dao
chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Chapter 0649: The Eighth Heavenly Stele and Hongjun's True Body
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen encounters the original body of Hongjun, a fearsome Stone King who attempts to steal the Dao imprints from the Eighth Heavenly Stele. He discovers that mastering the stele requires knowledge of all seven previous steles.
og_title: World of Immortality Ch 649: The Eighth Heavenly Stele
og_description: Xiao Chen witnesses a cunning Stone King—the true form of the false god Hongjun—attempting to steal the Dao from the Eighth Heavenly Stele using a Yin-Yang transformation.
